cards.text: Friend, Jesus has just been baptized in the Jordan, and a voice from heaven called Him God's beloved Son. Then the Spirit leads Jesus out into the wilderness. Pull up a stool, because this one's a showdown.

cards.question: Why does the Spirit lead Jesus out into the wilderness?

answers.text: To be tempted by the devil

cards.text: Out there, Jesus fasts forty days and forty nights, and after that, He's hungry. Friend, if my oven timer runs two minutes long, I'm pacing circles on my gold base.
Then the tempter comes to Him and opens with a big fat IF: “If You are the Son of God,” he says. Hold on. A voice from HEAVEN already said He is!

cards.question: Jesus is hungry, and the tempter points at the stones. He tells Jesus to make the stones become ___.
True or false: Jesus turns the stones into bread to prove to the tempter that He is the Son of God.
Jesus answers the tempter with Scripture: a man doesn't live on bread alone. What else does he live on?

answers.text: Every word that comes from the mouth of God
The strength God puts into his body
The work of his own two hands

cards.text: Round one goes to Jesus. Then the devil takes Him to the holy city and sets Him on the pinnacle of the temple, and friend, you put me near the edge of a counter and I start SWEATING.

cards.question: Up on the pinnacle of the temple, the devil tries his “If You are the Son of God” line again. What does he dare Jesus to do?

answers.text: Make the crowds bow to Him

cards.text: And now the devil quotes Scripture TOO: “He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.” Oh, so NOW he's a Bible scholar.

cards.question: Jesus won't jump. Same as with the stones, He answers the devil with ___.
True or false: The Scripture Jesus quotes back tells people not to put the Lord their God to the test.

cards.text: Third try. The devil takes Jesus to a very high mountain and shows Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory. ALL of them. Friend, for years the best view I had was the inside of a junk drawer.

cards.question: The devil offers Jesus all the kingdoms of the world, if Jesus will fall down and ___ him.

cards.text: “Away from Me, Satan!” Jesus tells him. No counteroffer. No sleeping on it. Done.

cards.question: Jesus sends Satan away and quotes Scripture one more time. Who does that Scripture say to worship and serve?
The devil finally leaves Jesus. Then ___ come and take care of Him.

findings.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the tempter's arrival, "Hold on.", and the callback to the voice from heaven. That exceeds the two-sentence limit.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The card supplies the first part of Jesus' reply and asks the baker to provide the unheard second part. The baker is being asked to guess the next words of the line rather than reason about its meaning.

rule.text: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

findings.problem: This non-opening story card has four sentences: "Third try.", the mountain sentence, "ALL of them.", and the junk-drawer joke. That exceeds the two-sentence limit.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The setup gives no basis for choosing "worship" over "obey" or "follow." The blank asks for wording the baker has not seen instead of a meaning they can reason out from the earlier cards.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
